title: Device Fingerprinting Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request information about device fingerprinting practices from websites. Learn what data they collect and protect your privacy.
description: A professional letter template to request transparency about device fingerprinting practices from websites and services. Use this template to understand how organizations collect and use your browser and device data for identification purposes.

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content: Subject: Request for Information Regarding Device Fingerprinting Practices

sections.heading: Opening Salutation
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Officer / Data Protection Team,

I am writing to request information about your organization's device fingerprinting practices as they relate to my privacy rights and data protection.

sections.heading: Purpose Statement
sections.content: As a user of your website/service, I would like to understand how your organization collects, processes, and uses device fingerprinting data. Device fingerprinting involves collecting information about my browser, device, and system configurations to create a unique identifier.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requests
sections.content:
I respectfully request the following information regarding your device fingerprinting practices:

1. What specific device fingerprinting techniques do you employ (e.g., canvas fingerprinting, WebGL fingerprinting, audio fingerprinting, font detection)?

2. What data points do you collect as part of your fingerprinting process (e.g., screen resolution, installed fonts, browser plugins, system specifications)?

3. What is the purpose of collecting this fingerprinting data (e.g., fraud prevention, analytics, advertising, user tracking)?

4. How long do you retain device fingerprinting data?

5. Do you share this fingerprinting data with third parties, and if so, with whom?

6. What measures can users take to opt-out of device fingerprinting on your platform?

7. Do you respect browser privacy settings such as 'Do Not Track' headers when collecting fingerprinting data?

sections.heading: Legal Basis Reference
sections.content: This request is made under my rights to transparency and information about data processing practices. If you are subject to GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy regulations, I believe I have the right to understand how my data is being collected and processed through fingerprinting techniques.

sections.heading: Response Timeline Request
sections.content: I would appreciate a response within 30 days of receiving this letter. If you need additional time to compile this information, please let me know your expected timeline.

sections.heading: Contact Information
sections.content: Please send your response to the contact information provided above. If you need any additional information to process this request, please don't hesitate to contact me.

sections.heading: Closing
sections.content:
Thank you for your attention to this matter and your commitment to user privacy and transparency.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Digital Signature if sending electronically]
